### Network, Community of Practice, and Group Sizes {#com-met}

Membership counts are organized as follows: Groups are listed under their parent Network or Communities of Practice (CoP). CoPs that belong to Networks are shown separately and not counted in the Network total. Group members are included in their parent Network or CoP count.

```{r}
#| label: community-sizes-table
# build the parent/child rows for the table
create_hierarchical_df <- function(parent_df, child_df, parent_type) {
  parent_df_display <- parent_df %>%
    left_join(community_tags %>% select(Tags, Display_Name), by = "Tags") %>%
    mutate(Display_Name = if_else(is.na(Display_Name) | Display_Name == "", Name, Display_Name))
  
  # children carry their own type, taken from community_tags
  child_df_display <- child_df %>%
    left_join(community_tags %>% select(Tags, Display_Name, Type.1), by = "Tags") %>%
    mutate(Display_Name = if_else(is.na(Display_Name) | Display_Name == "", Name, Display_Name))
  
  parent_child_pairs <- parent_df_display %>%
    select(Tags, Display_Name, Members, Privacy) %>%
    mutate(Type = parent_type) %>%
    left_join(
      child_df_display %>%
        filter(!is.na(Parent_Tag) & Parent_Tag != "") %>%
        select(Parent_Tag, Display_Name, Members, Privacy, Type.1),
      by = c("Tags" = "Parent_Tag"),
      relationship = "one-to-many"
    ) %>%
    mutate(has_children = !is.na(Display_Name.y))
  
  bind_rows(
    parent_child_pairs %>%
      distinct(Tags, Display_Name.x, Members.x, Privacy.x, Type) %>%
      transmute(
        Display_Name = Display_Name.x,
        Members = Members.x,
        Privacy = Privacy.x,
        Type = Type,
        Parent_Tag = Tags,
        Sort_Order = Members.x,
        Is_Parent = TRUE
      ),
    parent_child_pairs %>%
      filter(has_children) %>%
      transmute(
        Display_Name = indent_child(Display_Name.y),
        Members = Members.y,
        Privacy = Privacy.y,
        Type = Type.1,
        Parent_Tag = Tags,
        Sort_Order = Members.x,
        Is_Parent = FALSE
      )
  ) %>%
    arrange(desc(Sort_Order), Parent_Tag, desc(Is_Parent), desc(Members))
}
df_children <- bind_rows(df_group, df_cop)
network_hierarchical <- create_hierarchical_df(df_network, df_children, "a-Network")
df_cop_parents <- df_cop %>% filter(is.na(Parent_Tag) | Parent_Tag == "")
cop_hierarchical <- create_hierarchical_df(df_cop_parents, df_children, "b-CoP")
# put whichever group has the largest single community on top
max_network_size <- max(df_network$Members, na.rm = TRUE)
max_cop_size     <- max(df_cop$Members, na.rm = TRUE)
hierarchical_table <- if (max_network_size >= max_cop_size) {
  bind_rows(network_hierarchical, cop_hierarchical)
} else {
  bind_rows(cop_hierarchical, network_hierarchical)
}
parent_rows <- which(hierarchical_table$Is_Parent)
# short type labels; bold parent names so they survive fmt_markdown
hierarchical_table <- hierarchical_table %>%
  mutate(
    Type = recode(Type,
      "a-Network" = "N",
      "b-CoP"     = "CoP",
      "c-Group"   = "G"
    ),
    Display_Name = if_else(Is_Parent, bold_md(Display_Name), Display_Name)
  )

hierarchical_table %>%
  select(Display_Name, Type, Privacy, Members) %>%
  gt() %>%
  cols_label(
    Display_Name = "Name",
    Type         = "Type",
    Privacy      = "Access",
    Members      = "Members"
  ) %>%
  cols_align(align = "left",  columns = c(Display_Name, Type, Privacy)) %>%
  cols_align(align = "right", columns = Members) %>%
  fmt_markdown(columns = Display_Name) %>%
  text_transform(
    locations = cells_body(columns = Privacy),
    fn = access_badge
  ) %>%
  tab_style(
    style = cell_text(weight = "bold"),
    locations = cells_body(rows = parent_rows)
  ) %>%
  tab_style(
    style = cell_borders(sides = "top", color = collab$fg_weakest, weight = px(1)),
    locations = cells_body(rows = parent_rows[-1])
  ) %>%
  tab_source_note(
    source_note = md("*Type: N = Network, CoP = Community of Practice, G = Group.*")
  ) %>%
  collab_gt_theme()
```

### Engagement in the Largest Communities of Practice

The table below summarizes activity in the five largest Collaboratory communities of practice, including participation and engagement within their subgroups.

```{r}
#| label: top-cops-table


# Five largest CoPs by member count (users are computed from the latest snapshot).
# Topics, posts and likes come from data/manual/cop-activity.csv, with the community
# identified by Tags or by Community (display name), plus columns Topics, Posts, Likes.
# Communities missing from that file show n/a.
activity_cols <- c("Topics", "Posts", "Likes")
top_cops <- df_cop %>%
  arrange(desc(Members)) %>%
  slice_head(n = 5) %>%
  left_join(community_tags %>% select(Tags, Display_Name), by = "Tags") %>%
  transmute(
    Tags,
    Community = if_else(is.na(Display_Name) | Display_Name == "", Name, Display_Name),
    Users = Members
  )

cop_activity <- read_manual("cop-activity")
if (is.null(cop_activity)) {
  top_cops[activity_cols] <- NA_real_
} else {
  key <- if ("Tags" %in% names(cop_activity)) "Tags" else "Community"
  top_cops <- top_cops %>%
    left_join(cop_activity %>% select(all_of(c(key, activity_cols))), by = key)
}
top_cops <- top_cops %>%
  select(-Tags) %>%
  mutate(across(all_of(activity_cols), ~ ifelse(is.na(.x), "n/a", fmt_n(.x))))

top_cops %>% kable_collab()
```

### Cross-Community Map

```{r}
#| label: network-graph-prep

library(tidyverse)
library(tidygraph)
library(ggraph)

# ---- Prepare and filter user data ----
data1_groups <- data1 %>%
  select(id, group_names) %>%
  separate_rows(group_names, sep = ";") %>%
  filter(group_names %in% df_cop$Tags) %>%   # only keep CoP tags
  distinct(id, group_names)

# ---- Compute shared membership edges ----
group_pairs <- data1_groups %>%
  group_by(id) %>%
  summarise(
    group_pairings = if(length(unique(group_names)) >= 2) {
      list(combn(sort(unique(group_names)), 2, simplify = FALSE))
    } else {
      list(NULL)
    },
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  unnest(group_pairings) %>%
  filter(!is.null(group_pairings)) %>%
  mutate(
    from = map_chr(group_pairings, 1),
    to = map_chr(group_pairings, 2)
  ) %>%
  count(from, to, name = "shared_members")

# ---- Compute node sizes ----
node_sizes <- df_cop %>%
  select(Tags, Members) %>%
  distinct(Tags, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  rename(name = Tags, member_count = Members)

# ---- Build graph ----
community_graph <- tbl_graph(edges = group_pairs, directed = FALSE) %>%
  activate(nodes) %>%
  left_join(node_sizes, by = "name") %>%  # bring in member counts
left_join(community_tags %>% select(Tags, Display_Name) %>% distinct(Tags, .keep_all = TRUE), by = c("name" = "Tags")) %>% # bring in Display_Name from community_tags
  mutate(
    member_count = replace_na(member_count, 1),
    display_name = if_else(is.na(Display_Name) | Display_Name == "", name, Display_Name)  # fallback to tag if Display_Name missing
  )


```

```{r}
#| label: network-graph-plot
#| fig-height: 10
#| fig-width: 12
set.seed(cfg$layout_seed)  # same map on every render
ggraph(community_graph, layout = "fr", niter = 3000) + 
  geom_edge_link(aes(edge_width = shared_members), alpha = 0.4, color = collab$brand) + 
  geom_node_point(aes(size = sqrt(member_count)), alpha = 0.9, color = collab$cat0) + 
  geom_node_text(aes(label = display_name), repel = TRUE, size = 4, force = 10, color = collab$brand_stronger, fontface = "bold") + 
  scale_size_continuous(range = c(3, 12), name = "Group Size") + 
  scale_edge_width_continuous(range = c(0.5, 3), name = "Shared Members") + 
  theme_collab_map() +
  theme(
    plot.margin = margin(20, 20, 80, 20),   # extra space for stacked legends
    legend.justification = "center",
    legend.box = "vertical"                 # legends stacked vertically
  )

```
